_what: How Studio keeps the arm from hitting itself on a move (A46-1). A move is first tried as the straight joint path; only if that hits does the planner look for a way round. planner: rrt-connect (go round) or straight (refuse instead). checkDeg: biggest joint change between two checked points. stepDeg: how far the search grows per try. budgetMs: time allowed in the editor (video, recordings, talk gestures). liveBudgetMs: time allowed while following live - none found in time and the arm holds its last safe pose. shortcuts: tries at straightening the way round. seed: same seed, same path.
